title: Ledger: overview film
description: Hours, receipts and bank in one place. A narrated tour of Ledger on synthetic demo data, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 57 seconds: Ledger. One line per ticket; Checks explained, you confirm; Booked when exactly one invoice fits; Matched, suggested, missing. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Hours in Redmine, receipts in the inbox, bookings in the bank. Three places, one month-end.
Ledger turns them into invoices, checked receipts and a handover your accountant can use.
It imports billable hours from Redmine and drafts the invoice, one line per ticket.
Receipts arrive from mail, Drive or upload. AI reads number, date and VAT; you confirm.
Bank bookings come in over PSD2. Clear matches are booked; the rest waits for you.
The monthly statement shows every booking with its receipt, ready for the tax advisor.
